HOOLHEYAKMOD-ANALYSIS_POWER.title: Analysis
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ANALYSIS_POWER.description: A value used to enhance specific effects.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ANALYSIS_POWER.smartDescrip: A value used to enhance specific effects.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-MEANDER_POWER.title: Meander
HOOLHEYAKMOD-MEANDER_POWER.description:
For every [blue]5[/blue] Skills played, deal [blue]3[/blue] damage to a random enemy and apply [blue]1[/blue] Lift. Current progress: [blue]{Amount}[/blue] / [blue]5[/blue].
Triggers a number of times equal to your Analysis.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-MEANDER_POWER.smartDescript:
For every [blue]5[/blue] Skills played, deal [blue]3[/blue] damage to a random enemy and apply [blue]1[/blue] Lift. Current progress: [blue]{Amount}[/blue] / [blue]5[/blue].
Triggers a number of times equal to your Analysis.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ERUDITION_POWER.title: Erudition
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ERUDITION_POWER.description:
For every [blue]4[/blue] Attacks played, deal damage to a random enemy equal to your Analysis and apply [blue]1[/blue] Lift. Current progress: [blue]{Amount}[/blue] / [blue]4[/blue].
Triggers [blue]4[/blue] times.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ERUDITION_POWER.smartDescri:
For every [blue]4[/blue] Attacks played, deal damage to a random enemy equal to your Analysis and apply [blue]1[/blue] Lift. Current progress: [blue]{Amount}[/blue] / [blue]4[/blue].
Triggers [blue]4[/blue] times.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-GRAVITY_POWER.title: Gravity
HOOLHEYAKMOD-GRAVITY_POWER.description:
An innate property, equal to [blue]10%[/blue] of Max HP (rounded down). Current Gravity: [blue]{Amount}[/blue].
When the target's Lift reaches this value, triggers Levitate.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-GRAVITY_POWER.smartDescript:
An innate property, equal to [blue]10%[/blue] of Max HP (rounded down). Current Gravity: [blue]{Amount}[/blue].

HOOLHEYAKMOD-LIFT_POWER.title: Lift
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LIFT_POWER.description: When stacks reach Gravity, clears all stacks and triggers Levitate.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LIFT_POWER.smartDescription: When stacks reach Gravity, clears all stacks and triggers Levitate.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LEVITATE_POWER.title: Levitate
HOOLHEYAKMOD-LEVITATE_POWER.description:
Loses all Block and gains [blue]20[/blue] Deconstruction. Damage taken is increased by [blue]50%[/blue], and damage dealt is decreased by [blue]70%[/blue].
At the end of the turn, takes (Gravity + Lift) × 2 damage, then removes this status and clears all Lift.
